questions.stemHtml: A 42-year-old male patient presented with complaints of retrosternal burning sensation with chronic nocturnal cough since 5 months that has aggravated in the last 5 days. After initial evaluation the patient underwent the following investigation shown in the image. All are true regarding the given finding except:

options.label: A

options.label: B

options.label: C

options.label: D
